about: Shared timelines for WODTimerEngine (Swift, Shared/WODTimerEngine.swift) and its Kotlin port (android/). Each case builds an engine from `mode`, then runs `events` in order: `do` applies an action at `t` seconds, and `expect` is what the engine must report at `t`. The expectations are written by scripts/engine-fixtures/main.swift from the Swift engine; edit the cases, then run `scripts/engine-fixtures/generate.sh`. Both test suites read this file, so the two engines count the same.
